facts.fact: ATNOR's own site describes it as a public administrative establishment under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry that prepares and manages Chad's national standards, and records its technical committees adopting draft Chadian standards (NTD) on 31 July, 5 August (ten international quality-management standards as drafts) and 7 August 2026; none is on information technology or data.

systems.owner: Ministry of Commerce and Industry (supervising ministry)

note: No certification fact: the page names certification only as a general service for products and services, with no IT or data standard and no certified organisation; the adopted standards are drafts on quality management, electrotechnics and petroleum products.
